name: stride-watch-creds-migration
description: One-off migrations into Tencent MySQL: COROS/Garmin watch credentials from Azure Key Vault (provider_credentials), user profile + onboarding state from the local data/ snapshot (user_profile / user_onboarding), watch health data from the local coros.db snapshot (daily_health / daily_hrv / dashboard / race_predictions), and the athlete training goal from the local data/ snapshot (race_goal, plus an Azure master-plan snapshot goal_id rewrite when a legacy slug goal_id is re-minted).
